lines.text: در جانب مغرب بود خصومت اهل عدم از هیجا و کثرت اهل طغیان و اشتداد قحط
lines.en: in the western direction, there will be hostility from the people of non-existence from the tumult, and an abundance of people of rebellion, and the intensification of famine

lines.text: در ان ولایت با کثرت امراض و و با واگر زحل مستعلی باشد بیماری و علل و امراض بود

lines.text: و احراق اکثر ان بلاد و اشتداد قحط بود اما احوال زراعت نیکو بود ( و اگر در دلو
lines.en: and the burning of most of those lands, and the intensification of famine. However, the condition of agriculture will be good. (And if it is in Aquarius,

lines.text: باشد ) دلالت کند بر شدت و زحمت خلایق و قحط در اکثر بلاد و خلف میان ملوک
lines.en: it indicates hardship and trouble for the people, and famine in most lands, and disagreement among kings,

lines.text: و فقهاء و قضاة و موت و فناء عظیم و کثرت امطار و ثلوج و برد و دانها و حسن حال
lines.en: and jurists, and judges, and great death and mortality, and an abundance of rain, snow, and cold, and grains, and the good condition

lines.text: اهل فلاحت و اکراد و اهل جبال و افکندن بناهای بلند و تردد کاروانها و قصد

lines.en: and backbiting among the great ones, and the sinking of a people, and the rising of a group, and the growing great of thieves, and

lines.text: اسیب پادشاهان و هلاك بزرگان و تغییر در سیرتهای مردم و کثرت بحث و مناظره

lines.en: in the exact sciences, and a difference in prices. If Saturn is ascendant, hardship will reach the people, and famine

lines.text: در اکثر بلاد و قلت امطار و میاه و خشکی رودخانها و اگر مشتری مستعلی بود خوبی
lines.en: in most lands, and a scarcity of rain and water, and the drying up of rivers. And if Jupiter is ascendant, goodness

lines.text: و خوشی اهل بابل و ارزانی در ان ولایت بلکه در اکثر بلاد با کثرت امطار و ثلوج و
lines.en: and happiness for the people of Babylon, and cheapness in that province, rather in most lands, with an abundance of rain and snow, and

lines.text: میاه و طغیان رودخانها ( مقارنه مشتری و زحل در مثلثه مائی ) دلالت کند بر قوت
lines.en: water, and the overflowing of rivers. (The conjunction of Jupiter and Saturn in the watery triplicity) indicates the strength

lines.text: و رفعت مردم سفله و نقل دولت از طبقه علیا بطبقه سفلی و خذلان کردن قومی با پادشا

lines.text: و خوف سفاین و بودن سرما و بارندگی و خرابی از کثرت میاه و امطار و بسیاری
lines.en: and fear for ships, and the presence of cold and rainfall, and ruin from the abundance of water and rain, and an abundance

lines.en: of mosquitoes and fleas at the time, and most of these effects will be in the northern direction. (And if it is in Cancer,)

summary.headline: Saturn–Jupiter Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological predictions for conjunctions of Saturn and Jupiter in Aquarius and the watery triplicity, followed by effects of the conjunction in Cancer. The forecasts address famine, plague, rainfall, floods, agriculture, warfare, royal conflict, social upheaval, prices, and dangers to ships, with particular effects in Babylon, Arab lands, and northern regions.
